title: Planning Goal Status
description: A seller's evaluation of one planning goal against one proposal version.

enumDescriptions.met: The proposal satisfies the goal as the seller's forecast sees it.
enumDescriptions.missed: The proposal does not satisfy the goal. target and achieved, or unmet_items, say by how much.
enumDescriptions.not_supported: The seller cannot plan against or evaluate this goal. It is reported rather than silently ignored, so the buyer knows nothing was optimized toward it.
